headword: {産学連携|さんがくれんけい}

definitions.explanation: Cooperative activities between industry (businesses) and academic institutions (universities, research labs), such as joint research, technology transfer, and sponsored programs.

examples.japanese: {産学連携|さんがくれんけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{新技術|しんぎじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: New technology was developed through industry-academia collaboration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{産学連携|さんがくれんけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れている→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: The university is putting effort into industry-academia partnerships.

notes:
USAGE:
A key concept in Japanese science and technology policy. Government initiatives actively promote {産学連携|さんがくれんけい} to accelerate innovation and technology transfer from universities to industry.
